subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should this issue stay open for a true separated/merged channel conversation view, be narrowed to the already-implemented Sessions table channel grouping, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace issue?
rationale: Current main implements channel grouping for session rows, but a merged all-channel conversation timeline would require product decisions about transcript aggregation, privacy, routing, and how it relates to the broader sessions workspace.

options.title: Define merged timeline semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open and scope the remaining work around explicit separated/merged channel conversation semantics before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to row grouping
options.body: Treat the current Sessions table channel grouping as sufficient for now and close or retitle this issue to avoid promising a merged transcript timeline.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Move the remaining merged/peek/inline-reply discussion into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace tracker.

recommendation.title: Define merged timeline semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and scope the remaining work around explicit separated/merged channel conversation semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent main implementation for session grouping and channel categorization is in this person's history, making them the best current routing candidate for the product/API follow-up.
